title: Removal of the Aft Cargo Door Surround Longitudinal Splice Plates
abstract: Removal of the longitudinal splice plates from the aft cargo door surround with the door off the aircraft, including the fastener accountability and the inspection of the exposed frame land.

sections.purpose: This task removes the longitudinal splice plates from around the aft cargo door cut-out so that they can be renewed or so that the exposed frame land can be inspected and repaired.
sections.job_setup_note: The aft cargo door must be removed and put on a padded stand before this task starts. The door surround is a pressure boundary and every fastener removed must be recorded. The cut-out loses stiffness once the plates are off, so the fuselage must not be moved on jacks and no other work may be done on the aft fuselage while the plates are removed.
sections.procedure: 1. Remove the aft cargo door and put it on the padded stand. 2. Remove the lining panels local to the cut-out from inside the aft cargo compartment in zones 131, 134 and 145. 3. Do a detailed visual inspection of the surround and record any deformation before removal. WARNING: DO NOT MOVE THE AIRCRAFT ON JACKS WHILE THE SPLICE PLATES ARE REMOVED. THE CUT-OUT LOSES A LARGE PART OF ITS STIFFNESS. 4. Remove the sealant fillet from the plate edges with a plastic scraper. 5. Record the position of every fastener on the removal sheet. 6. Remove the fasteners along the upper and lower edges. CAUTION: DO NOT DAMAGE THE EDGING GROMMET AES686504-33 WHERE THE WIRING ROUTE CROSSES THE FASTENER LINE. DISCONNECT AND MOVE THE ROUTE FIRST. 7. Lift the splice plates clear and put them on a padded surface. 8. Remove the superseded intercostal D5230111892105 if it is fitted. 9. Do a detailed visual inspection of the exposed frame land and the stringer D5230114751500 and record every finding. 10. Check the microswitch of FIN 6804WV1 for damage and correct rigging. 11. Protect the open fastener holes with temporary plugs.
sections.close_out: Bag and label the removed fasteners and confirm the removal sheet is complete. Cover the exposed cut-out to keep it clean and dry. Leave the door on its stand with the latches in the closed position. Make an entry in the aircraft technical log that the cargo door surround is open and that the aircraft must not be pressurised or jacked.

safety_precautions: Do not move the aircraft on jacks while the splice plates are removed.
Support the door on a padded stand with the latches closed.
Account for every fastener removed on the removal sheet.
Disconnect the wiring route before you remove the fasteners near it.

tooling.description: Door handling stand, aft cargo door
